a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: In-Patient Treatment
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: We will cover the following Medical Expenses incurred in respect of Hospitalisation of the Insured Person during the Policy Period, up to the Sum Insured: Room Rent (Single AC Room), Boarding, Nursing Expenses, ICU charges (no sub-limit), Surgeon fees, Anaesthesia, Blood, Oxygen, Operation theatre charges, Diagnostic materials, Medicines and drugs, Medical devices. Note: Associated Medical expenses which vary based on the room occupied by the insured person will be considered in proportion to the room rent stated in the policy schedule or actuals whichever is less.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Room Rent Proportionate Deduction
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: If the Insured Person occupies a room with rent exceeding the eligible room rent as per the policy schedule, all associated medical expenses that vary based on room category shall be reduced proportionately. Formula: Payable Amount = Billed Amount × (Eligible Room Rent / Actual Room Rent). This proportionate deduction applies to: Surgeon fees, Anaesthetist fees, Specialist consultation fees, Operation theatre charges, and any other charges that differ based on room category. ICU charges and expenses that do not vary by room category are not subject to proportionate deduction.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Pre and Post Hospitalisation
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Medical expenses incurred during 60 days prior to the date of admission and 90 days after the date of discharge, related to the disease/illness/injury for which the Insured Person was hospitalised, shall be covered under the policy.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Daycare Procedures
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: The Company covers 546 listed daycare procedures that require hospitalisation of less than 24 hours due to advances in medical technology. These include but are not limited to: Cataract surgery, Dialysis, Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy, Lithotripsy, Tonsillectomy, Arthroscopy, and all procedures listed in Appendix B.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Waiting Periods
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Initial Waiting Period: 30 days from the policy start date (except for accidents). Specific Diseases Waiting Period: 24 months from the policy start date for: Cataract, Benign ENT disorders, Hernia, Joint replacement, Kidney/Urinary stone treatment, Piles/Fistula, Sinusitis, Internal tumours. Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: 36 months from the first policy start date for all declared pre-existing conditions.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Permanent Exclusions
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: The Company shall not be liable for expenses on account of: Cosmetic or plastic surgery (unless necessitated by accident or burns); External congenital anomalies; War, invasion, act of foreign enemy; Nuclear/chemical/biological weapons contamination; Circumcision unless medically necessary; Vaccination except for post-bite treatment; Cost of spectacles, hearing aids, and contact lenses; Treatment for Change of gender; Treatment for Obesity/Weight management (BMI-based exclusion).

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Ambulance Charges
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Road ambulance expenses incurred for transportation of the insured person to and from the hospital shall be covered subject to a maximum of Rs. 2,500 per hospitalisation.
